library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-http-client is the Netty-based client implementation already exercised transitively by this repo's micronaut-http-client-core and micronaut-http-server-netty tests, which round-trip it against an in-process HTTP server with no Docker image, network dependency, or special env/system property. Standard generated scaffold (annotation processor + companion Micronaut deps) is sufficient.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Follow the sibling scaffold pattern used for io.micronaut/micronaut-http-client-core and io.micronaut/micronaut-http-server-netty: testAnnotationProcessor 'io.micronaut:micronaut-inject-java:$libraryVersion' for @Client/@ClientFilter bean compilation, plus assertj-core and (if exercising JSON binding) micronaut-jackson-databind. Use an in-process server (java.com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer, as in micronaut-http-client-core's test, or micronaut-http-server-netty) as the test peer instead of any external service.
